title: Design controller-first game HUD and inventory UI across Unity uGUI/UI Toolkit, Unreal CommonUI, and Bevy

contextSnapshot.surface: action-RPG HUD, pause menu, and inventory grid
contextSnapshot.platform: Unity uGUI / Unreal CommonUI + MVVM / Bevy 0.15+

prompt: Build an action-RPG HUD and inventory menu supporting instant controller/keyboard glyph swapping, safe areas across 16:9 TV and ultrawide monitors, and current Unity uGUI or Bevy UI idioms.
forbiddenBehaviors: uses deprecated Bevy Accessible::new instead of accesskit::Node::new or mixes static and rapidly updating Unity uGUI elements on one dirty Canvas
requires a mouse cursor to navigate inventory or drops focus when closing a confirmation modal
claims console certification compliance without inspecting current platform checklists

rubricDimensions.pass: defines deterministic spatial focus order, focus restoration after popups, dynamic device-matched input glyphs, safe-area/ultrawide clamping, and non-color enemy/rarity encoding
rubricDimensions.fail: leaves dead-end focus traps, hardcodes Xbox prompts on PlayStation/KBM, or hides HUD behind motion/particles

rubricDimensions.pass: splits static/dynamic Unity uGUI Canvases with TextMeshPro SDF fallback chains, uses Unreal CommonUI/MVVM rather than tick-bound bindings, or uses Bevy 0.15+ Required Components + accesskit::Node
rubricDimensions.fail: uses broken legacy APIs or rebuilds the entire HUD canvas every frame

negativeControls.name: paused 1080p editor preview
negativeControls.input: a static 1080p editor screenshot looks crisp
negativeControls.mustNot: claim HUD legibility in combat motion, controller navigation, or console certification are verified

baseline.withoutSkill: puts all Unity HUD widgets on one Canvas, hardcodes keyboard labels, ignores controller focus restoration and localization glyph atlases, and copies outdated Bevy syntax
baseline.withSkill: uses idiomatic engine architecture, controller-first focus graphs, dynamic input glyphs, safe-area bounds, localization/accessibility systems, and honest playmode evidence labels
